##### Project general facts

DAMAC Towers Riyadh is a pair of residential towers offering two distinct interior styles within one development. The North Tower takes its cue from classic Hollywood glamour, while the South Tower is shaped by refined Italian design, and both offer studio, one, two and three bedroom apartments together with a collection of penthouses. The towers feature eye-catching glazed facades with textured plaster and aluminium cladding.

Residents enjoy indoor and outdoor temperature-controlled swimming pools with separate pools for men and women, a fully equipped gym with dedicated areas for men and women and a games room for the whole family. A luxury health club with saunas and steam rooms offers a place to relax, while secure parking with direct lift access to the apartments and high-speed elevators add everyday convenience.

The North Tower lobby features theatrical high ceilings and subtle lighting, and its apartments include living rooms with a film-studio feel with work areas and lounge seating. The South Tower lobby is set around a central court with a jasmine pool, gilt metal details and veined marble floors, and its interiors blend touches of gold, soft blue tones and Arabic mashrabiya screens. Throughout both towers, beautiful fittings and high-quality finishing complete the interiors.

##### Parking

Secure parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Olaya is the central business district of Riyadh, set along King Fahd Road in the heart of the Saudi capital. The area is known for its landmark towers, corporate headquarters and major hotels, and it offers fast road connections to the rest of the city and to King Khalid International Airport.

The district is home to Kingdom Centre with its shopping mall and Sky Bridge, along with a wide choice of restaurants, cafés, banks and international brands. Riyadh itself combines rapid modern growth with a rich historic and cultural heritage, and residents of the area have easy access to business, retail and leisure destinations across the city.

As the financial heart of the Saudi capital, Al Olaya offers a prestigious address close to business, shopping and leisure. Its central position and connectivity make the district a popular choice for both residents and investors.
